products.title: PlayStation 5 Digital Edition
products.description:
Bundle containing the Sony PlayStation 5 Digital Edition console and a Black PS5 DualSense wireless controller. The bundle includes a 825 GB SSD-equipped PS5 with 4K HDR graphics capabilities and support for up to 120 fps, along with a black DualSense controller featuring a blue lightbar accent for a sleek, modern look. The bundle is designed for enhanced gaming with fast load times and immersive features like haptic feedback and adaptive triggers, ready for couch co-op and online play. Includes stock-keeping information and delivery options available from Currys in Ireland.

Key features: PS5 Digital Edition, 825 GB SSD, 4K HDR, up to 120 fps, USB-C charging, DualSense wireless controller (Midnight Black with blue light accents), HDMI, WiFi, Ethernet, Bluetooth, huge library of games (subscription options available).

products.title: PlayStation 5 Digital Edition Console
products.description: Experience the next generation of gaming with the Sony PlayStation 5 Digital Edition Console. Enjoy lightning-fast loading with an ultra-high-speed SSD, immerse yourself in rich gameplay with haptic feedback and adaptive triggers, and hear every detail with Tempest 3D AudioTech. This all-digital console means no disc drive, so you can dive straight into downloading games from the PlayStation Store. It supports stunning 4K visuals, up to 120fps gameplay, and HDR technology for a vibrant, lifelike experience. With its sleek design and powerful capabilities, the PS5 Digital Edition is designed for those who want to play games in ways never before possible.

products.title: PlayStation 5 Pro
products.description: The SONY PlayStation 5 Pro is a high-performance gaming console designed for immersive, blazing-fast gameplay. It features 4K graphics enhanced by an upgraded GPU and PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution, alongside Advanced Ray Tracing for life-like light and reflections. With a massive 2 TB SSD, WiFi 7 for lower latency, and support for 60 Hz or 120 Hz gameplay, it ensures smooth action. The console is backwards compatible with over 8,400 PS4 games and includes a DualSense wireless controller with haptic feedback and adaptive triggers for a more tactile experience.

products.title: PlayStation 5 Digital Edition Game Console
products.description: The Sony PlayStation 5 Digital Edition (CFI-2100 slim model) is a next-generation game console designed for a streamlined, digital-only setup. It features an 825GB ultra-high-speed SSD for near-instant load times, a custom AMD Ryzen Zen 2 CPU, and an AMD Radeon RDNA 2-based graphics engine with ray tracing for stunning 4K visuals. This edition does not include a disc drive, relying on the PlayStation Store for game downloads. It supports haptic feedback and adaptive triggers via the included DualSense wireless controller, as well as Tempest 3D AudioTech for an immersive auditory experience. The console is backward compatible with over 8,500 PS4 games.

products.title: PLAYSTATION PS5 DualSense Edge Wireless Controller - Midnight Black
products.description: Customise the DualSense Edge controller to make every button and stick behave exactly how you need. You can fine-tune the stick sensitivity, pick from 3 caps for the perfect grip and even swap out the whole stick modules. You've got 2 styles of back buttons to choose from, to fit your play-style. The trigger buttons have adjustable trigger stops and dead zones – great for fast and precise shooting. You can remap buttons to fit your favourite games and switch between different profiles on-the-fly. Everything you know and love about the DualSense controller remains, including haptic feedback and adaptive triggers. Multi-device connectivity lets you connect via USB Type-C or Bluetooth to PS5, PC, Mac or smartphone. Includes carrying case and USB-C cable with lockable housing.

products.title: DualSense Edge Wireless Controller
products.description: Elevate your gaming experience with the PlayStation DualSense Edge Wireless Controller in white. This advanced controller offers unparalleled customization, allowing you to fine-tune stick sensitivity, dead zones, and trigger travel distance for a personalized feel. Remap buttons, create custom control profiles, and utilize the swappable back buttons for quick access to essential actions. Enjoy immersive gameplay with adaptive triggers and haptic feedback, and extend your playtime with easily replaceable stick modules. Designed for serious gamers, the DualSense Edge provides a competitive edge and ultimate comfort.

products.title: Game Drive for PS5
products.description: The Seagate Game Drive for PS5 is an officially licensed external hard drive designed to seamlessly extend the storage capacity of PS5 and PS4 consoles. It offers 5TB of add-on storage, allowing gamers to expand their library without deleting titles. The drive features a stylish white design with integrated Blue LED lighting and utilizes a USB 3.2 (Gen 1 Type-A) interface for efficient data transfer.
